en.hubeali:
Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘If there is a grove wherein there are no reeds, something from the fish having been taken out, so whatever is in the grove can be sold’.
en.sarwar: 11. Sahl ibn Ziyad has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr from certain persons of his people who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If there is a bunch of trees without reeds with a few fish taken out along with what is in the bunch of trees, it can (lawfully) be sold.’”
